NONE: › connected with the environment
與環境有關的；生態的
› an examination of how the behaviour of a business or group of people affects the environment
環境稽核（評估企業或人們行為對環境造成的影響）

example: After our eco-audit, we switched to low-energy light bulbs.
環境稽核後，我們改用耗電量低的燈泡。

NONE: › an
ecological footprint
› Eco-friendly products have been designed to do the least possible damage to the environment.
環保的；不損害環境的
› an official symbol that shows that a product has been designed to do less harm to the environment than similar products
環保品牌標識；生態產品標記
› a person who argues against and tries to stop activities that damage the environment
（積極投身環保活動的）生態鬥士
B2 relating to ecology or the environment
生態的；生態學的；環保的

example: The destruction of the rain forests is an ecological disaster.
雨林遭破壞是一種生態災難。

NONE: › the amount of the earth's energy that someone or something uses
生態足跡（某人或某物佔用的地球資源量）

example: I'm trying to reduce my ecological footprint by cycling more and driving less.
我試圖透過多騎車、少開車的方法減少我的生態足跡。

NONE: › a person who studies the natural relationships between the air, land, water, animals, plants, etc.
生態學家
C1 the relationships between the air, land, water, animals, plants, etc., usually of a particular area, or the scientific study of this
（通常指一個特定區域的）生態；生態學

example: The oil spill caused terrible damage to the fragile ecology of the coast.
石油外泄給脆弱的海岸生態環境帶來嚴重的破壞。
She hopes to study ecology at college.
她希望在大學裡讀生態學。

NONE: › the testing of the performance of economies and economic theories using mathematical methods
計量經濟學

before noun: B2 [ before noun ] relating to trade, industry, and money

NONE: › making a profit, or likely to make a profit
産生經濟效益的；有利可圖的；能賺錢的

example: The country has been in a very poor economic state ever since the decline of its two major industries.
自從這個國家的兩大主要産業衰退後，其經濟一直萎靡不振。
The government's economic policies have led us into the worst recession in years.
政府的經濟政策使我們遭遇了多年來最爲嚴重的經濟衰退。
We had to close our London office - with the rent so high it just wasn't economic.
我們不得不關閉倫敦辦事處——租金太高，不划算。

NONE: › a person who leaves their home country to live in another country with better working or living conditions
經濟移民（為追求更好的工作或生活條件而移民別國的人）
B2 not using a lot of fuel, money, etc.
經濟的；省錢的；節約的

example: There's increasing demand for cars that are more economical on fuel.
對低油耗汽車的需求與日俱增。
What's the most economical way of heating this building?
給這棟大樓供應暖氣，怎樣做才是最經濟的方法？

NONE: › avoiding stating the true facts about a situation, or lying about it
隱瞞真相；撒謊；不完全說出真相
› using little money, time, etc.
經濟地；節約地；節儉地
› in a way that relates to a country's trade, industry, and money
有關國家貿易、產業和財政地

example: As a student she lived very economically, rarely going out and buying very few clothes.
作為一名學生，她生活非常節儉，很少外出娛樂，也很少買衣服。
Economically, the country has been improving steadily these past ten years.
在過去的十年中，這個國家的經濟穩定發展。

NONE: B1 the way in which trade, industry, or money is organized, or the study of this
經濟狀況；經濟因素；經濟學

example: Their ideas sound fine in principle, but they haven't worked out the economics behind the policies.
他們的計劃理論上聽起來不錯，但是他們沒有搞清楚這些政策背後的經濟因素。
She's in her third year of studying economics at York University.
她在約克大學主修經濟學，現在上大三。

NONE: B2 a person who studies or has a special knowledge of economics
經濟學家
› to try to save money by reducing the amount that you are spending
節約，節省；緊縮開支

example: You could economize on food by not eating in restaurants all the time.
如果你不總是去餐廳吃飯，就可以在吃這方面節省很多。
A lot of companies are trying to economize by not taking on new staff.
很多公司為了盡可能節省開支，都不再僱用新員工。

C: B2 [ C ] the system of trade and industry by which the wealth of a country is made and used

C or U: › [ C or U ] the intentional saving of money or, less commonly, the saving of time, energy, words, etc.

example: the global economy
全球經濟
the German/US economy
德國／美國經濟
the state of the economy
經濟狀況
a weak/strong economy
疲軟／強勁的經濟
Tourism contributes millions of pounds to the local economy.
旅遊業帶來數百萬英鎊的地方收入。
They've had to make economies since Nathan lost his job.
自從南森失業以來，他們不得不節儉度日。
This can be done by machines with more speed and economy.
這可以用機器來完成，又快又經濟。
She writes with such economy - I've never known a writer say so much in so few words.
她惜墨如金——我從沒見過哪位作家能如此言簡意賅。

NONE: › (using) the cheapest and least comfortable type of seats on an aircraft
（客機的）經濟艙；乘坐經濟艙

example: They always fly economy class.
他們總是乘坐經濟艙。

NONE: › an attempt to save money by spending as little as possible
勤儉節約

example: I don't think we'll be going anywhere expensive - Guy's on an economy drive.
我想，我們不會去任何花太多錢的地方——蓋伊正勒緊褲帶存錢呢。

NONE: › a larger amount of goods that you buy for a lower price
（大包裝、價格低的）經濟裝
deep vein thrombosis  (= a sticky mass of blood in the lungs or in the tubes that carry blood to the heart) that someone develops after travelling on a plane
› Economy-size products contain an amount that is larger than normal and can be bought for a lower price.
（商品）經濟裝的
› all the living things in an area and the way they affect each other and the environment
生態系統

example: Pollution can have disastrous effects on the delicately balanced ecosystem.
污染會對脆弱的生態平衡造成災難性的破壞。

NONE: › the business of organizing holidays to places of natural beauty in a way that helps local people and does not damage the environment
生態旅遊
